claim: Under TWSE's Key Points for classifying listed companies' industries (2025.06.09), an initial-listing applicant is placed in an industry category when one business activity provides more than 50% of its operating income in each of its two most recent fiscal years (or 80% or more in the most recent year), and TWSE adjusts listed companies' industry categories periodically every year.
evidence: "公司有所營任何一項業務之營業收入占其全部營業收入之比率超過百分之五十以上者，以該項業務為其上市產業類別" (Point 3(1)); "最近一個會計年度...超過百分之八十以上者" (Point 3 para 2); "本公司每年定期調整各上市公司之產業類別" (Point 5, Chinese text)
notes: Corrects CLM-2189: the English translation says 'biyearly', but the prevailing Chinese text says 每年定期調整 ('periodically adjusts every year'). English page note: 'In case of any discrepancy between the Chinese version ... and this English translation, the Chinese version shall prevail.'
